glosses: mattress (a piece of furniture where one sleeps, with a covering of sponge or other flexible material or even springs, and which is generally placed on top of a bed frame)
contingency fund, reserve fund (funds set aside to meet possible needs)

examples.text: Você já dormiu num colchão de água?
examples.en: Have you ever slept on a water bed?
Tom slept on the inflatable mattress.

examples.text: Você realmente esconde seu dinheiro debaixo do colchão?
examples.en: Do you really hide your money under the mattress?
Tom slept on an inflatable mattress.
